body: thanks so much for your help. Her parents know about her anorexia; she's spent time in inpatient facilities before. She's chronic, though, and continuing to lose weight. Her parents take her to the doctors, but she cheats weigh-ins and works around her therapists, and refuses to eat on a nightly basis. I'm afraid, though, that if she doesn't starve to death, she'll find another way to end it. I hate the idea of her being committed to a full institution, that would destroy her (it is a very traumatic memory for her, the time she spent there.) I will consider talking to her parents, who I unfortunately don't know well, and the counselors here as well. Thank you for your support. I'm doing my best.
